description: Public Service Commission - Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Surveyors' Service 4 th Amendment
categorisation: This gazette notification amends the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Surveyors' Service, which pertains to public service recruitment, qualifications, and promotion criteria. It involves public service administration matters including qualification requirements, promotion procedures, and salary increments for government surveyors, falling under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) rather than government structural/personnel changes.
